Package renderer

Class PixelManager

java.lang.Object
renderer.PixelManager
public class PixelManager extends Object
The PixelManager class handles concurrent pixel processing for ray tracing. It provides thread-safe methods for: - Allocating pixels to different threads for processing - Tracking rendering progress - Displaying completion percentage at specified intervals This class is essential for implementing efficient multi-threaded rendering.

  • Method Details

    • nextPixel

      public Pixel nextPixel()
      Returns the next pixel to process in a thread-safe manner. This method ensures that each pixel is processed exactly once, even when called from multiple threads.
      Returns:
      The next pixel to process, or null if all pixels are allocated

    • pixelDone

      public void pixelDone()
      Marks a pixel as processed and optionally prints progress. This method is called after a pixel has been fully rendered. When the specified progress interval is reached, it prints the current completion percentage to the console.
